_comment: Walk the road loop while 10 level-36..40 casters chase and cast particle-heavy spells (fire/ghost/water/bone) plus 2 melee. Heaviest realistic case: AI, pathing, attack slots, projectiles and emitters together. Always use --fresh (spawns persist).
